title: xbench EN 16931 subset — model output contract (v1)
description: Structured JSON that every model adapter MUST return. models/xml_builder.py turns this into XRechnung 3.0.2 (CII D16B) XML. Models NEVER write XML directly. Field keys are EN 16931 Business Terms; the numbering below was verified against the standard's own rule texts (BR-12..BR-15, BR-CO-10..17, BR-09/11, BR-22..27) on 2026-11-12.

bt-2.description: Invoice issue date. Ground truth ISO 8601; predictions in DE format (DD.MM.YYYY) are accepted and normalized by scoring.

bt-9.description: Payment due date (optional; conditional on payment terms, BR-CO-25)

bt-10.description: Buyer reference — the Leitweg-ID in German B2G (mandatory in XRechnung, BR-DE-15)

bt-31.description: Seller VAT identifier (DE…), BR-CO-09 country prefix

bt-48.description: Buyer VAT identifier (often absent in B2G — used for the hallucination metric)

bg-23.description: VAT breakdown (one entry per VAT category)

bt-82.description: Payment means type code (58 = SEPA credit transfer)

bt-130.description: Invoiced quantity unit of measure code (BR-23): C62 piece, HUR hour, MON month

bt-117.description: VAT category tax amount (= BT-116 x BT-119/100, BR-CO-17)

bt-120.description: VAT category code (S standard, AE reverse charge, E exempt, Z zero)

bt-106.description: Sum of invoice line net amounts (BR-12)

bt-110.description: Invoice total VAT amount (= sum of BT-117, BR-CO-14)

bt-112.description: Invoice total amount with VAT (= BT-109 + BT-110, BR-CO-15)

bt-115.description: Amount due for payment (= BT-112 - BT-113 + BT-114, BR-CO-16)

x-abstention: Any field may be absent, null, the literal string "not_found", or an uncertainty wrapper {"value": x, "uncertain": true}. scoring treats all four as an abstention, reported as coverage vs accuracy-on-answered — never as a wrong guess.
x-normalization: scoring/normalize.py compares amounts with Decimal and a ±0.01 tolerance, dates in ISO or DD.MM.YYYY, IBANs stripped of spaces and uppercased, VAT ids uppercased, names casefolded.
